scenes.transcript: You know, fate, or some mysterious force, can put the finger on you or me, for no good reason at all.
scenes.description: A weary man sits at a diner counter, illuminated by neon light reflecting off rain-slicked glass.
scenes.synopsis: Our anti-hero reflects on fate and bad luck in a roadside diner, the noir philosophy laid bare.

scenes.transcript: There ought to be a law against dames with red hair.
scenes.description: A close-up of a woman's face, half-hidden in shadow, cigarette smoke curling upward.
scenes.synopsis: The femme fatale makes her entrance, immediately establishing dominance over the protagonist.

scenes.transcript: No matter what I did, no matter how I tried to shake it, that shadow was always there.
scenes.description: The protagonist walks alone down a dark highway, a single pair of headlights approaching in the distance.
scenes.synopsis: Trapped by circumstance, the protagonist accepts his inevitable doom as the net closes in.
